name: Autumn's Journey
source:
Ishtera is populated by two races: dragonkind, who have lived there for eons, and the heavenkind who have recently appeared. The two races have been politely aware of each other, but never intervening, only keeping to their own business. Until now.

Kerr, one of the pupil earth dragons, is cursed by his master after an incident and forced into an unfamiliar human form. He can’t return to his kin until he has atoned for his impudence while learning more about the heavenkind.
